title: 第5章 好吃的眼泪都飆出来了第6章 碰上硬茬子了
slug: 漂亮后妈要翻身我在七零养崽崽
content_zh:
看著小傢伙毫不畏惧看著她，那双眼睛里充满了审视。
苏灿很明白，自己想要获得三个孩子的信任还需要一段时间。
他们对自己的態度她一点也不介意。
“你们两个把手和脸洗乾净，我买了绿豆糕，洗不乾净的没有份哦。”说完领著甜甜走进了屋子里。
听到绿豆糕三个字，陆文浩哇的一声，赶紧跑到水盆前洗脸洗手。
陆文渊看了看屋子里，似乎还不敢相信这件事。
“哥，快洗呀，要不然你可没绿豆糕吃。”
水盆里的水被陆文浩洗的跟游泳一样，溅出来一大半。
陆文渊听弟弟的话也赶紧凑过来洗。
苏灿带著甜甜进了屋，打开包袱，从里面拿出了一斤绿豆糕。解开外面的包装纸，从里面拿出一块绿豆糕递给甜甜。
记住我们101看书网
小姑娘拿著绿豆糕咽了咽口水，扭头看向炕上的陆战东。
“甜甜自己吃，爸爸也有的。”
苏灿拿了一块也递给了陆战东。
看看手里的绿豆糕，再看看眼前的苏灿，陆战东嗓音有些沙哑：“苏灿，谢谢你……”
“谢什么？我们以后就是一家人了。”
“你把这个留给孩子们吧。”这么奢侈的东西，陆战东哪里捨得吃。
“你现在是伤员，更应该补充营养。再说了，我买了好几斤呢。”
姜玉容不知从哪里弄到了很多票，苏灿离开县城之前，把她手里能用的票全用上了。
当时差点没把姜玉容给气昏过去。

听她这么说，陆战东的手才收了回去。
陆文浩和陆文渊很快也进了屋，看到苏灿怀里的绿豆糕时，陆文浩的眼睛贼亮贼亮的，不停的直咽口水。
陆文渊不说话，一张小脸一直紧绷著，但是眼睛也不时看著苏灿手里的绿豆糕。
他虽然是这个家里的老大，但是说到底也还是个孩子。
苏灿看著两人笑笑，分別给了两人一块。
陆文浩一口咬下去，绿豆糕软软的，甜甜的，香香的，糯糯的，好吃的他的眼泪都飆出来了。
苏灿又拿了两块大白兔奶递给了陆文渊，小傢伙有点高冷，就算是从来没吃过的奶脸上的表情也是绷著的。
但是吃了一口绿豆糕，眼睛也跟著亮起来。
太好吃了。
他们从来没有吃过这么好吃的东西。
要知道平常连填饱肚子这种事，对他们来说都是一种奢侈。
看孩子吃的高兴，苏灿也拿了一块吃了。
吃东西的时候，她顺便问了下家里的情况。
老二陆文浩因为吃了这个胖阿姨的绿豆糕，对苏灿的態度瞬间热情起来。
还特意跑到箱子前打开了盖子。
苏灿走过去一看，破旧的木箱里是这个家全部的家当了。
除了一床陆战东的军被，还有一些破衣，看著都像是別人穿过的。其他再就是陆战东的几件军装了。
苏灿看著这些寒酸的东西，不是一般的无语。
这些东西加起来，还不如她带来的东西多。
苏灿很想问陆战东，为什么就这么点东西？可是想想还是放弃了。

他一个大男人到了这种地步，已经是力不从心了。
可那是以前，现在她来了。
苏灿当下决定把他身下铺的那床破军被扔掉，因为实在是太脏了，又脏又臭，坐在屋子里她都感觉吃不下东西。
content_en:
Seeing the little guy looking at her without fear, his eyes were full of scrutiny.
Su Can knew very well that it would take some time for him to gain the trust of his three children.
She didn't mind their attitude towards her at all.
"You two, wash your hands and faces. I bought mung bean cake. Those who can't wash it will not get a share." After saying that, he led Tiantian into the house.
When Lu Wenhao heard the words "mung bean cake", he hurriedly ran to the basin to wash his face and hands.
Lu Wenyuan looked around the room, as if he still couldn't believe this.
"Brother, wash up quickly, otherwise you won't have any mung bean cake to eat."
The water in the basin was washed by Lu Wenhao as if swimming, and most of it splashed out.
After hearing his brother's words, Lu Wenyuan quickly came over to wash himself.
Su Can brought Tiantian into the house, opened the bag and took out a pound of mung bean cake. He unwrapped the outer wrapping paper and took out a piece of mung bean cake and handed it to Tiantian.

The little girl took the mung bean cake and swallowed, then turned to look at Lu Zhandong on the kang.
"Eat Tiantian by yourself, daddy also has some."
Su Can took a piece and handed it to Lu Zhandong.
Looking at the mung bean cake in his hand, and then at Su Can in front of him, Lu Zhandong's voice was a little hoarse: "Su Can, thank you..."
"Thank you for what? We will be a family from now on."
"You leave this to the children." How could Lu Zhandong be willing to eat such a luxurious thing.
"You are a wounded person now, so you should supplement your nutrition. Besides, I bought several kilograms."
Jiang Yurong got a lot of tickets from somewhere. Before Su Can left the county, she used all the tickets she could use.
At that time, Jiang Yurong almost fainted from anger.
After hearing what she said, Lu Zhandong retracted his hand.
Lu Wenhao and Lu Wenyuan soon entered the room. When they saw the mung bean cake in Su Can's arms, Lu Wenhao's eyes were bright and he kept swallowing his saliva.
Lu Wenyuan didn't speak, his little face remained tense, but his eyes looked at the mung bean cake in Su Can's hand from time to time.
Although he is the eldest son of the family, he is still a child after all.
Su Can looked at the two of them and smiled, giving them a piece each.
Lu Wenhao took a bite. The mung bean cake was soft, sweet, fragrant, glutinous, and so delicious that he burst into tears.
Su Can took two more pieces of white rabbit milk and handed them to Lu Wenyuan. The little guy was a bit aloof. Even though he had never eaten milk, the expression on his face was tense.
But after taking a bite of mung bean cake, my eyes lit up.
So delicious.
They had never eaten anything so delicious.
You must know that even filling their stomachs is a luxury for them.
Seeing that the child was happy eating, Su Can also took a piece and ate it.
While eating, she asked about the situation at home.
The second eldest child, Lu Wenhao, suddenly became enthusiastic towards Su Can because he ate the fat aunt's mung bean cake.
He even ran to the box and opened the lid.
Su Can walked over and took a look, and found all the family's belongings in the dilapidated wooden box.
In addition to a military quilt belonging to Lu Zhandong, there were also some rags that looked like they had been worn by others. The others are some of Lu Zhandong's military uniforms.
Su Can looked at these shabby things and was speechless.
The sum of these things is not as much as what she brought.
Su Can wanted to ask Lu Zhandong, why only such a small thing? But after thinking about it, I gave up.
As a grown man, he has reached this point and is already beyond his capabilities.
But that was before, now she is here.
Su Can immediately decided to throw away the shabby bed underneath him because it was so dirty, dirty and smelly that she felt like she couldn't eat even while sitting in the room.
